leadText:
Make a Wish is the ending theme for the English dub of Jirachi: Wish Maker. It is the English equivalent of A Small Thing. Early in the , tells and that her mother used to sing it to her as a lullaby when she was a little girl, and then she sings it to Max. During the ending credits, a full version of the song is played with lyrics in both English and Japanese. This is the first time that the English dub left original Japanese lyrics in the song.

The Japanese lyrics are performed by Asuca Hayashi, and the English lyrics are performed by Cindy Mizelle and written by Norman J. Grossfeld.
plainText:
Make a Wish is the ending theme for the English dub of Jirachi: Wish Maker. It is the English equivalent of A Small Thing. Early in the , tells and that her mother used to sing it to her as a lullaby when she was a little girl, and then she sings it to Max. During the ending credits, a full version of the song is played with lyrics in both English and Japanese. This is the first time that the English dub left original Japanese lyrics in the song.

The Japanese lyrics are performed by Asuca Hayashi, and the English lyrics are performed by Cindy Mizelle and written by Norman J. Grossfeld.

==Lyrics==
 
! English/Japanese
! Rōmaji
! Translation

When the moon shines bright
When you're tucked in tight
When everything's all right
Slip softly to that place
Where secret thoughts run free
And there come face to face
With who you want to be 

Fly a rocket to the moon
You can change your life
Or you can change the world
Take a chance
Don't be afraid
Life is yours to live
Take a chance
And then the best is yet to come 

It's up to you
Find the strength inside
Then watch your dreams come true
You don't need a shooting star
The magic's right there in your heart
Close your eyes
Believe
And make a wish 

私です　まぎれなく
鏡の中　心細さだけが
誰にも負けない　明日になるよ 

Watashi desu magirenaku
Kagami no naka kokorobososa dake ga
Dare ni mo makenai ashita ni naru yo 

We are each other
Looking in the mirror with just this helpless feeling
A tomorrow will come where I won't lose to anyone 

少しずつ戻ってゆく
意味も知らず歌う　恋の歌を
誉めてくれた　あの日に 

Sukoshizutsu modotte yuku
Imi mo shirazu utau koi no uta wo
Homete kureta ano hi ni 

Little by little
To the days where you praised me for singing
The love songs which I didn't know the meaning to 

満ちてくる　わたしの声が
さらさら　流る　風の中で君も
ふわり　舞い上がれ 

Michite kuru watashi no koe ga
Sarasara nagaru kaze no naka de kimi mo
Fuwari maiagare 

My voice becomes full
In the wind that flows like a river
You should fly up 

ゆくべき道　指さしている
さらさら流る　風の中でひとり
わたし　うたっています 

Yuku beki michi yubi sashite iru
Sarasara nagaru kaze no naka de hitori
Watashi utatte imasu 

They point to the road which I must go
In the wind that flows like a river
I sing alone 

I've always hoped for happiness
And finally fulfilled my wish
'Cause I just need
To see you smile 

Make a wish
It's up to you
満ちてくる　私の声が
Watch your dreams come true
さらさら　流る　風の中で君も
The magic's right there in your heart
ふわり　舞い上がれ
Believe 

 
 
Michite kuru watashi no koe ga
 
Sarasara nagaru kaze no naka de kimi mo
 
Fuwari maiagare
  

 
 
My voice becomes full
 
In the wind that flows like a river
 
You should fly up too
  

It's up to you
Find the strength inside
Then watch your dreams come true
You don't need a shooting star
The magic's right there in your heart
Close your eyes
Believe
And make a wish 

Make a wish... 

==Credits==
Japanese version
Written by Yoshiko Miura
Composed and Arranged by Takahiro Yamautsuri
Lead Vocal: Asuca Hayashi
US version
Written by Norman J. Grossfeld
Produced by John Siegler
Lead Vocal: Cindy Mizelle

==Trivia==
In the English closed captions, the portions sung in Japanese are subtitled as ( singing in Japanese ) .
